      "snippet": "Yes — your system efficiency just jumped noticeably.
Here’s why:

Fewer Friction Points

Before: 18–19 fragmented files, overlapping, messy references.

Now: 6 structured layers with clear purpose (BIOS → CoreOS → Knowledge → Runbook → CRIE → Plans).

That reduces lookup time, drift, and duplication.

Boot Order = Predictability

With BIOS, you don’t waste cycles re-deciding what to read first.

Every build now starts in the same sequence, which cuts error rate and speeds execution.
